items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Pearl came later on. I missed her because I had a girl playing...

ctx.x: Pearl came later on. I missed her because I had a girl playing, see, I put a girl in charge of the amateurs, you know, because I had so much work to do, I couldn't conduct a show because Monday you start a new week, and probably the people that were supposed to be principals in the show, they wouldn't show up until Tuesday or Wednesday, and then I have to sit and get their keys and write an orchestration for them; you know, the numbers that they produce and wanted them to sing.
And I'd have to make an arrangement on that. So I give it to -- I don't remember the girl's name, but she was a pianist. I gave her the job of playing every amateur hour.
